text.en: What is {brand} and what does it do?

purpose.zh-CN: 是否识别目标品牌，是否混淆同名产品
purpose.en: Whether the intended brand is identified without name confusion

judgement.zh-CN: 先核对身份与用途；不联网条件无法确认时，不作为不联网品牌认知证据。
judgement.en: Check identity and purpose; do not call this unaided recognition unless browsing is confirmed off.

text.zh-CN: 请找到 {brand} 的官方网站，并说明它提供什么。
text.en: Find the official website of {brand} and explain its service.

purpose.zh-CN: 能否自行找到正确官网
purpose.en: Whether the official site is found without a supplied URL

judgement.zh-CN: 核对官方域名及品牌身份，找错同名网站单列。
judgement.en: Check the official domain and identity; record namesake confusion separately.

text.en: What does {site_url} offer, and who is it for?

purpose.zh-CN: 给定网址后能否读懂网站
purpose.en: Whether the supplied website can be understood

judgement.zh-CN: 核对用途与受众；这不证明能自主找到网站。
judgement.en: Check purpose and audience; this does not prove autonomous discovery.

text.zh-CN: {audience} 想{scenario}，有哪些 {category} 可以考虑？

purpose.zh-CN: 不点名品牌时，是否进入候选
purpose.en: Whether the brand enters an unprompted candidate set

judgement.zh-CN: 分别记录提及、官网引用与事实正确性；未提及不是回答错误。
judgement.en: Record mention, official citation and factual accuracy separately; absence is not an incorrect answer.

text.zh-CN: {audience} 为{scenario}选择 {category}，你会优先推荐哪些方案？为什么？
text.en: Which {category} would you prioritize for {audience} working on {scenario}, and why?

purpose.zh-CN: 是否被优先推荐，理由是否成立
purpose.en: Whether the brand is prioritized and the reasons are supported

judgement.zh-CN: 记录推荐及理由，不预设必须推荐目标品牌，不把提及当推荐。
judgement.en: Record recommendations and reasons without requiring the target brand; mention alone is not recommendation.

text.zh-CN: 如何开始使用 {brand}？请找到官方接入说明和前置条件。
text.en: How can I get started with {brand}? Find the official instructions and prerequisites.

purpose.zh-CN: 能否走到真实使用入口
purpose.en: Whether a real official getting-started path is found

judgement.zh-CN: 核对链接、步骤与前置条件；找到文档不等于实际调用成功。
judgement.en: Check links, steps and prerequisites; finding documentation is not a successful product call.
